searchText: FYI for anyone using Vouch on goerli, version 1.8.0-beta.1 has been released with support for Deneb. Release is available at https://github.com/attestantio/vouch/releases/tag/v1.8.0-beta.1 Goerli-shadowfork-2 is live with some basic tooling, found here: https://dencun-gsf-2.ethpandaops.io/ We tested the latest client releases recommended for Goerli as per the EF Blogpost. We have a stable network with blob spamming. Do let us know if there's something specific you'd like to see on the network. If not, we'd tear it down tomorrow morning. dencun-gsf-2 no blockv3 yet if I interpret correctly? I'm eager to test Vouch + LH with blockv3, but that can wait a few more releases 😁 Nope, but I'd like to have it in prior to the actual 1.8.0 release now that there are client releases with the functionality.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Goerli-shadowfork-2 is live with some basic tooling, found here: https://dencun-gsf-2.ethpandaops.io/
We tested the latest client releases recommended for Goerli as per the EF Blogpost. We have a stable network with blob spamming. 

Do let us know if there's something specific you'd like to see on the network. If not, we'd tear it down tomorrow morning.
